promptNotes.text: GTX 1050 Ti checks are batched, not run per unit. When your work needs the reference GPU (E-04), write a section `## GTX check owed` in the handoff with the exact steps and the expected numbers, set `needsHumanCheck: true`, and continue; do not return `blocked` for it. A decision already marked Decided in docs/decisions/02-open.md (E-07, E-08, E-09, E-10) is settled; do not ask it again.
